in_sanskrit.name: शुवम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who returns or welcomes back

in_hindi.name: शुवाम
in_hindi.meaning: शुव - शुरुआत के लिए, वापस आना, वापस लाना (shuruat ke liye, vapas aana, vapas lana) - beginning, return, bring back
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who brings back or is the beginning of something

in_tamil.name: ஷுவம்
in_tamil.meaning: ஷுவ - வாழ்த்தல் (vaihttal) - welcome ம் - m (a small letter that indicates the nasal sound in Tamil script)

in_telugu.name: శువమ్
in_telugu.meaning: శువ - ఆయ్యపోయే (ayyapoye) - welcome back మ్ - m (a small letter that indicates the nasal sound in Telugu script)

in_marathi.name: Shuvam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shuvam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who invites, welcomes, or calls back. A new beginning, a fresh start.

in_bengali.name: Shuvam
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Welcome, Return
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shuvam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who invites, welcomes, or calls back. A new beginning, a fresh start.
